reg [63:0]  vram_word_buf;   // accumulate 8 bytes → 1 DDRAM write
// ~2^25 / 53e6 ≈ 630 ms -- far longer than any real DDRAM latency.
//           slot = 96KB = 98304 bytes; minus 8-byte control word = 98296 bytes → 24574 words
